title: Chapter 307 Lin Dabiao Is Really Awesome
content:
Chapter 307 Lin Dabiao Is Really Awesome

The spears were like sharp arrows, quickly killing the nearby skeleton soldiers.

The health of a level 60 skeleton was only 5,000 to 8,000.

It only took a few spears to kill one, which was quite efficient.

At least it was much more effective than dealing with people, and it was safe to kill from a distance.

After Wang Shuo left a team of people to protect the crossbow battalion, he led the Hell Knights and headed towards the city lord's mansion.

He had been to this place once and was familiar with the terrain in the city.

Along with Wang Shuo, there were also generals under the command of various lords.

This time they were going to deal with a group of high-level generals headed by the bloodthirsty demon wolf.

Ordinary soldiers were useless in front of them.

Lin Xiaodong was still at ease in the face of the siege of several high-level generals.

He suddenly raised his eyes and saw the arrival of reinforcements, and he was overjoyed.

"Lin County Magistrate, hold on, we will rescue you."

"Okay, I can still hold on, you guys quickly destroy the undead skeletons in the city."

The bloodthirsty demon wolf not far away snorted coldly when he heard it.

"You can still hold on, but I haven't made a move yet."

A small ball shining with strange light spit out from his mouth and went towards Lin Xiaodong.

Although Lin Xiaodong had already discovered and defended the small ball with all his strength, he was still repelled by it and fell on a pillar, spitting blood.

His health value dropped by one third directly.

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank sharply when he saw this scene.

I'm afraid that his small body can't withstand the magic attack of this bloodthirsty demon wolf.

At the gate of the lord's mansion.

Lin Xiaodong's guards also have 4 high-level generals, while the bloodthirsty demon wolf has 10 high-level generals and at least 20 level 60 skeleton elites.

As for Wang Shuo, there were only 5 high-level generals who followed him, but there were quite a few mid-level generals, at least more than 20, and the three-headed dog troops of Hell.

When Wang Shuo was on the road, he had already handed the high-level general transfer scroll to Ayub.

Including the high-level generals of other lords, there were only 5 people in total, and the number seemed to be equal.

But a bloodthirsty demon wolf could break the balance of combat power.

Lin Xiaodong only had the strength of a top-level general, while the bloodthirsty demon wolf was a general.

In this battle, Wang Shuo had no way to use the bronze crossbow cart.

First, the distance was too far to attack, and second, the terrain in the city was too narrow, with soldiers fighting everywhere, and there was no way to place a large number of bronze crossbow carts.

A single one was not very meaningful.

After all, Wang Shuo's full-strength attack had already caused more than 2,000 points of damage.

At this time, Wang Shuo could only rush forward with his head held high, and the arrow was on the string, and he had to shoot.

Wang Shuo asked Gude to stand on the beam in the distance and use bows and arrows for remote support.

He and Ayub will first clear out the nearby skeleton generals.

As for Lin Xiaodong's battle, let him hold on for a while.

His health is still more than half, and he will not be in danger in the short term.

Wang Shuo believes that he must have a way to save his life and will not be defeated so quickly.

With the addition of new forces, the battle finally came to a stalemate.

Gong Zheng transformed into a giant, and from time to time he swung in front of the bloodthirsty wolf to attract his attention and share some damage with Lin Xiaodong.

The bloodthirsty wolf was quite annoyed with this stone man, and he grabbed it and slapped it away.

At this time, another figure blocked him.

Lin Xiaodong was also shocked. There was still someone who dared to challenge the bloodthirsty wolf.

This person was a general under Bu Lanlan, named Lin Dabiao.

He was big and strong, and he was comparable to Gong Zheng who had not transformed.
